# Bundle: cms-comp-ops

A CMS computing operations knowledge instance - sites, storage, datasets and workflows from the CMS catalogs, site status, CMSSW releases, and the operational memory of past incidents.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Extends | [`cern-team`](cern-team.md) |
| Okg versions it supports | `>=0.2.0,<0.3` |

## Packs

- Default: [`cms-catalogs`](../packs/cms-catalogs.md), [`cmssst`](../packs/cmssst.md), [`cmssw-releases`](../packs/cmssw-releases.md), [`ops-record`](../packs/ops-record.md)
- Optional: [`monit-live`](../packs/monit-live.md), [`dqm`](../packs/dqm.md), [`hypernews`](../packs/hypernews.md), [`jira`](../packs/jira.md), [`git-code`](../packs/git-code.md), [`ticket-triage`](../packs/ticket-triage.md)
- With [`git-code`](../packs/git-code.md), also: [`code-text`](../packs/code-text.md) (opt out with `--without`)

Default packs install with the bundle. Add an optional pack with `--with <pack>` at init, or `archi add <pack>` later.
The bundle also installs the default packs of the bundles it extends.

```bash
archi init myteam --bundle cms-comp-ops
```

## Chat preset

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| `site_name` | `CMS computing operations chat` |

Suggested questions:

- Which storage endpoints does a given site have, and what is its status?
- Which workflows read a given dataset, and where is it hosted?
- Which downtimes are scheduled for a site, and what happened the last time it had one?

## Automation level bounds

The bundle sets no bound. Each automation pack's own limit applies.
